name: Kohath
description: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The ending "ites" denotes the people of; the Kohathites are the people of Kohath. They numbered 8,600 and pitched on the side of the tabernacle southward.

note.label: Numbers 3: The Levites Taken Instead of the Firstborn

points: After Aaron and his sons made an end of covering the sanctuary, the sons of Kohath came to bear it, but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. The Most High is very particular about the most holy things.

note.label: Numbers 4: The Service of the Tabernacle Done in Order

points: Unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders. Numbers 4 shows what that bearing was: Aaron and his sons covered the ark and the vessels first, and after that the sons of Kohath came to bear them, not touching any holy thing lest they die.

note.label: Numbers 7: The Offering of the Princes at the Dedication of the Altar

points: The order of the march is given camp by camp: Judah with Issachar and Zebulun first; the tabernacle taken down and borne by the sons of Gershon and Merari; then Reuben with Simeon and Gad; then the Kohathites bearing the sanctuary, and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came; then Ephraim with Manasseh and Benjamin; and last Dan with Asher and Naphtali, the rereward of all the camps.

note.label: Numbers 10: The Silver Trumpets and the Order of the Journeys

points: The cities came out by lot family by family: the children of Aaron the priest, of the Kohathites, had thirteen cities out of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin; the rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities out of Ephraim, Dan, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: The families of the children of Kohath that remained had four cities out of Ephraim, including Shechem in mount Ephraim to be a city of refuge for the slayer, four cities out of Dan, and two out of the half tribe of Manasseh: ten cities in all.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: The sons of Levi are named, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and the line runs through Kohath and Amram to Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: The sons of Levi are set down again by their families: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, with the sons that came from each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: These are they that waited with their children, the singers of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, and his line traced back through Levi to Israel.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: David divided the Levites into courses among the sons of Levi, namely Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and named their families and their sons in order down the line. He names the father and then names the children, and then names that one's children, going down the line, which is like an inheritance each of them received.
